command:
set -eu
cd /work
tar -xf - --no-same-owner -C /work
test -f Candidate.ml && test -f checker.ml
/home/opam/.opam/5.5/bin/ocamlc -w +a -o probe Candidate.ml checker.ml >compile.stdout 2>compile.stderr
# Limit candidate stdout/stderr files to 64 KiB and make the hard limit
# irreversible for the unprivileged compiled process.
ulimit -Hf 128
ulimit -Sf 128
set +e
./probe >candidate.stdout 2>candidate.stderr
candidate_status=$?
set -e
printf 'SFT_CANDIDATE_STATUS:%s\n' "$candidate_status"
cat compile.stdout compile.stderr candidate.stdout candidate.stderr
printf '%s\n' 'SFT_PROBE_COMPLETE_eaded0db4ba7dcdcf8c952d754d8de6c'
test "$candidate_status" -eq 0
error: container compile/assertion failed or completion sentinel missing
